items.title: Related Experience
items.content:
Innovation Ambassador · Launch Lab, University of Rhode Island

May 2024 to present · Kingston, RI

  • Promote Launch Lab’s resources and programming across the College of Business
  • Supervise the Launch Lab space in Carothers Library
  • Attend Innovate at URI events and recommend new workshops and hackathons
  • Share activity, successes, and challenges at weekly ambassador meetings
  • Onboard and mentor six new ambassadors

Office Assistant · Small Business Development Center

June 2021 to April 2024 · Kingston, RI

  • Observed consultations with local small businesses
  • Tracked small business interactions in Excel, analyzing needs and trends
  • Created a PowerPoint presentation showing how the center’s services are used
  • Attended Chamber of Commerce events promoting the SBDC

Mobile Unit Driver · Del’s Lemonade

June 2020 to July 2021 · Narragansett, RI

  • Sold product at Narragansett Beach during the summer, managing financial records and register receipts
  • Drove the truck to and from sales locations daily
  • Learned how pricing and positioning affect sales, and how family-owned franchises operate

items.title: Personal Projects
items.content:
Campus Cold Brew Pop-Up

Tested a weekend cold brew stand outside the library to learn lean start-up methods first-hand.

  • Ran three weekend tests with a $150 budget
  • Interviewed 40 students about price and flavor
  • Broke even by the second weekend and documented the results for Launch Lab

Small Business Social Media Kit

Designed a free template kit that helps local shops plan a month of posts in an afternoon.

  • Built with three Kingston businesses as first users
  • Shared through the Small Business Development Center

Want details on either project? Reach out.
